record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, reduce only the existing training-frequency input-feature amplitude from 0.04 to 0.02: scale visible item vectors by 1+0.02*tanh(z), using the same standardized log1p training-item counts. Weaker frequency modulation may preserve useful context cues while limiting popularity distortion; the timed-out 0.08 trial supplies no quality conclusion. Keep padding and mask scales at one, checkpoint the feature buffer, and preserve embeddings, topology, readout, loss and optimizer.
